query:
UPDATE quotes q
           SET state = CASE WHEN old.state = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END,
               approval_uri = NULL,
               updated_at = now()
           FROM (SELECT id, state FROM quotes WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE) old
           WHERE q.id = old.id AND old.state <> 3
           RETURNING old.state AS old_state, q.state AS new_state
